claims.claim: Readings are illustrations of documented model types, not claims about any named company's treatment of any person.
None of the five asks what the person needs.
What matters is which model is switched on.
A promotions model scored each customer's "elasticity": whether an offer would bring in more losses than it cost.
A consultant described predicting members' "capacity to give" and "likelihood of dropping out"; one firm sent churches neighborhood "risk reports."
A chatbot that remembers you is sold as a monthly tier, $9.99 at Character.AI.
